item.title: Celebrities with big streaming projects this 2026
item.description: Giant streaming platform Netflix Philippines just announced its slate for 2026. They will be releasing five originals this year--three series and two films. They have also tapped some of the country's most popular and beloved stars to topbill these upcoming projects. Check out these celebrities who have big projects with the streaming giant here.

item.title: Lian Paz shares heartbreaking Valentine's Day with the death of pet dog Luka
item.description: It was supposed to be a happy day but Valentine's Day turned somber for the family of former EB Babes Lian Paz after their pet dog Luka passed away. The ex-partner of Bubble Gang star Paolo Contis took to Instagram to mourn the death of their fur baby by uploading a carousel of photos of their best moments with Luka. item.title: Family Feud: Team M and M vs Team Almendras
item.description: Maghaharap ang Team M and M at Team Almendras ngayong Chinese New Year (February 17) sa "More Tawa, More Saya, More Love" episode ng 'Family Feud!' Watch the latest episodes of 'Family Feud Philippines,' weekdays at 5:40 p.m. GMA Network, hosted by Kapuso Primetime King Dingdong Dantes. You can also watch it online via Kapuso Stream.

item.title: House of Lies: Fake Father | Episode 22
item.description: May announcement si Thea (Kris Bernal) tungkol sa kanyang pagbubuntis, pero si Edward (Martin del Rosario) daw ang ama? Ano kaya ang nangyari at biglang napagtakpan ang kasalanan ni Paolo (Mike Tan)? Huwag palampasin ang mga eksena sa 'House of Lies,' mula Lunes hanggang Biyernes, 3:20 p.m. sa GMA Afternoon Prime at Kapuso Stream.

item.title: Hating Kapatid: Belle in danger (Teaser Ep. 101)
item.description: Ngayong Martes, anak ang magbabayad sa kasalanan ng mga magulang! Subaybayan 'yan mamaya sa 'Hating Kapatid,' 2:30 p.m., sa GMA Afternoon Prime.

item.title: Tricky Love: Kevin vs Naomie (Teaser)
item.description: Kevin (Push Puttichai Kasetsin) brings even more pain to Naomie's (Lily Pantila Win Pansirithanachote) heart. How will this all end? Catch the Thai drama series 'Tricky Love,' weeknights at 11 p.m. on GMA.

item.title: Sang'gre: Pag-ibig ni Daron kay Armea (Episode 177 Teaser)
item.description: Kahit ipagkait ng tadhana, hinding-hindi bibitaw si Daron (Jon Lucas) sa kanyang pag-ibig para kay Hara Armea (Ysabel Ortega). Abangan 'yan sa 'Encantadia Chronicles: Sang'gre,' 8:05 p.m. sa GMA Prime at 9:45 p.m. sa GTV. Mapapanood din ito online via Kapuso Stream sa Facebook at YouTube.

item.title: Family Feud: Fam Huddle with Team Never Forget and Team Paco | Online Exclusive
item.description: Narito ang fam huddle ng Team Never Forget at Team Paco para sa "More Tawa, More Saya, More Love" tapatan sa 'Family Feud!' Tumutok na sa pinakamasayang family game show sa buong mundo na 'Family Feud,' Lunes hanggang Biyernes, 5:40 p.m. sa GMA.

item.title: Carlos Yulo spends birthday with kids in Pampanga
item.description: Two-time Olympic gold medalist Carlos Yulo celebrated his 26th birthday on February 16. The champion gymnast chose to hold a simple celebration in a church in Pampanga. Carlos brought a simple meal and gave some gift bags to a group of children. He also received a blessing from the parish priest. "Salamat Lord sa panibagong taon ng buhay, isa na namang biyaya na buong puso ko pong tinatanggap. "Lubos din po akong nagpapasalamat Fr.
